title: Codex workflow for answering S/370 and MVS questions
summary: A repeatable workflow reduces per-page PDF work while retaining primary-source verification.
workflow: classify the question: storage, control, execution, interruption, instruction, I/O or operator
open the sphere article for the concept map
jump to the printed page range
read the local definition and cross-references
return a short answer with printed page and quoted term evidence
